text: {"lessons":["Recent account gains and losses are not reliable signals for what prices will do next, so I should avoid reacting to short-term moves.","I should assess each holding on its prospects and portfolio role, not let average cost or reluctance to admit a mistake dictate whether I sell.","Selling Stock E and Stock D after sizable gains felt satisfying, but a gain by itself is not a reason to sell; I should avoid cutting winners without a sound portfolio-based reason."]}
